best_idea: A fixed channel pool with a per-source cap, a 50 ms double-start guard and a steal order that takes the oldest channel of the same source first and never the player's own channel; loops are declared each frame and merged per sound.
decision_why: Keep the cap, the double-start guard, the steal order and the per-frame loop merge for hit and spell cues and crowd loops; fix the donor's listener fallback so the player's own cue is never stolen; equal-power pan to be tested as a replacement for the linear one.
acceptance: A client unit test on ChannelPool: ten hit cues from one goblin in one second never put more than 4 copies of the same clip on that source at once; a repeat inside 50 ms is refused; when the pool is full a new cue is refused rather than stealing the player's own channel.
